matching: lowercased text; whole-word; longest match first, non-overlapping; regexes below are case-insensitive Python regexes over the lowercased text
verb_frame_first: Within one segment: if FRAME-tier hits exist, they decide (exactly one distinct Noetic, else AMBIGUOUS_STATE_IN_SEGMENT); else NAME-tier hits decide (exactly one); else NOUN-tier hits decide (exactly one); else NO_STATE_IN_SEGMENT. This is the 'verb frame first' rule of TRANSLATOR_SPEC section 3, applied to free English.

number_word_rule: a number word counts only when followed by an optional '(part|parts|unit|units|measure|measures|portion|portions)' and then 'of', and only outside any Noetic phrase hit (so 'one thing leads to another' and 'one's experiences' are never numbers)
